shortBulletSummary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains Neutral (46-47) while Bitcoin maintains price levels around $78K.
Ethereum successfully finalized its 25 millionth block and prepares for the Glamsterdam upgrade to triple gas limits.
Ethereum faces downside risks and is lagging behind Bitcoin performance despite recent $49 million purchase by BlackRock.
Morgan Stanley predicts interest rate cuts may be delayed until 2027 due to elevated inflation and changing Fed rhetoric.
Global market uncertainty and rising oil prices result from ongoing Iran-US tensions and new trade tariffs on EU vehicles.
